# mailgun_subaccount (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an existing Mailgun subaccount by ID. Subaccounts are child accounts that share the same plan as the primary account but have their own domains, users, and settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the subaccount.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The name of the subaccount.
- `status` (String) The status of the subaccount: 'enabled' or 'disabled'.
